players.name: Michael Penix
players.note: Penix hurt his ribs late in the 30-23 OT loss to BAL on Oct 11. Schefter reported Oct 12 that the injury is not considered serious, and Penix says he expects to play Week 6 vs CHI. Stefanski would not share the imaging results Monday and said the team will know more Wednesday; Tua Tagovailoa starts if he can't go.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Lamar missed Week 5 with a left ankle sprain. Jesse Minter said Oct 12 he is 'definitely doing better' and Rapoport reports 'some hope' he plays Week 6 vs CLE. How much he practices this week decides between him and Tyler Huntley.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.note: Williams (Grade 2 hamstring) was inactive for the 31-7 Week 5 loss at GB, where Bagent was benched for Keenum after the backups combined for 4 turnovers. Ben Johnson said Oct 11-12 Williams is 'close' and 'on track', and Rapoport says 'all signs point' to a Week 6 return at ATL.

players.name: Will Shipley
players.note: Left the Week 5 loss to JAX in London on Oct 11 with a foot injury, the same foot that limited him in Week 3. He scored a TD before he left. No MRI result or timeline had been reported as of Oct 13. Dameon Pierce (11 carries for 14 yards) and Carson Steele were the only healthy Eagles RBs.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Hurt his groin in the Oct 11 win over TEN (26-3) and was ruled out of the game. DeMeco Ryans calls him week-to-week and Aaron Wilson reports he could miss time. Week 6 is vs JAX in London.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Took most of the Texans' backfield work after Montgomery (groin, week-to-week) left on Oct 11. The only other back is Dare Ogunbowale, so Marks projects as the lead back for Week 6 in London.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Ruled out Oct 11 with an ankle injury and scheduled for tests Monday (Oct 12); roundups say it is not expected to be long-term. No test results were found as of Oct 13.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Seen in a walking boot on his right foot after the 17-12 loss at the Jets on Oct 11 (14 carries for 44 yards), per the Akron Beacon Journal. His Week 6 game vs BAL is in doubt, and backup Raheim Sanders also left with a hip injury. One roundup instead calls it an ankle injury and day-to-day.

players.name: Aaron Jones
players.note: Was carted off and evaluated for a knee injury vs NO on Oct 11 but came back for the next drive. He has had knee problems since Week 2, and MIN is on bye in Week 6.

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.note: Ankle injury from a 16-yard run in the Week 5 loss to SF; he did not miss significant snaps. He was listed as limited on Monday's (10/12) estimated report, and reports expect him to play Thursday (TNF) at DEN with no restrictions.

players.name: Deebo Samuel
players.note: Right hamstring injury in Week 5. Shanahan said on 10/12 that it 'got him pretty good' and he will miss 'at least a couple of weeks', likely covering Week 6 vs WAS and Week 7 at ATL before the bye.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Inactive for MNF at LAR on 10/12 (Bills won 37-34 in OT) with the AC joint injury in his left shoulder. Keon Coleman and Khalil Shakir absorb the snaps while he is out. His Week 6 status is not yet known.

players.name: CeeDee Lamb
players.note: Left Week 5 vs TB in the 4th quarter with a quad injury. Schottenheimer and Rapoport (10/12) called it a bruise, not long-term. He is not guaranteed to play Week 6 at GB, and Wednesday's practice report will tell more.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Week 5 vs TB was season-high on every line: 9-130-1 on 13 targets (31% share). His Week 6 role at GB could grow if Lamb's quad bruise limits him.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Has missed two games with a hamstring injury. Sirianni said on 10/12 he is 'hopeful' Smith returns in Week 6 vs CAR, and Garafolo says he has 'a shot'. It depends on Wed-Fri practices.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Has been on IR with a high ankle sprain since Week 1 and is now eligible to return for Week 6 vs NYJ. Vrabel said this week there is 'a chance', but there is no firm timeline.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Canales said on 10/12 that Coker (quad, hurt Week 3) is on track to return in Week 6 vs PHI after the Week 5 bye, depending on a full week of practice.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Missed Week 5 at NO with a hamstring injury. Rapoport reports the consensus is that he returns in Week 7 after the Vikings' Week 6 bye.

players.name: Brian Thomas
players.note: Had 0 catches on 3 targets in the Week 5 win over PHI. He has only six targets over the last three games, and Parker Washington has outsnapped him, so his role is shrinking.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Michael Pittman Jr. went on IR on 10/10. In the Week 5 win over IND, Bernard went 6-80 and led the team with 9 targets, and Roman Wilson's finger injury could add snaps.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Tyquan Thornton was placed on IR on 10/12 (ankle). Reid said Allen could 'work into the mix' more, especially if Rashee Rice (hamstring) misses Week 6 vs LAC. Allen has only 10 offensive snaps so far.

players.name: Marvin Harrison
players.note: Trade from ARI to HOU became official Oct 12 after he passed his physical. Sleeper's 'Out' is likely left over from his Week 5 deactivation, not an injury. He's expected to be HOU's WR2 behind Nico Collins with C.J. Stroud, his Ohio State QB, though he has only 5-85-1 on the season.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Came back from a two-game hip/groin absence on MNF Oct 12 with a career-high 17 catches (24 targets) for 138 yards and 1 TD in a 37-34 OT loss to BUF. No new injury was reported.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Hurt his hamstring in the 3rd quarter vs DEN Oct 11 and did not return. Harbaugh said Oct 12 he is 'week-to-week'. Week 6 vs KC is in doubt and the LAC bye is Week 7, so a Week 8 return is the likely target.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Dislocated a finger in the 2nd quarter of the Week 5 win over IND (Oct 11). ESPN's Fowler reported Oct 12 that he is expected to miss multiple weeks, possibly 'a couple', and a second opinion is pending.

players.name: Michael Pittman
players.note: Steelers put him on IR Oct 10 after his foot (plantar fasciitis) flared up. Earliest return is Week 10 (Nov 15) because of the Week 9 bye.

players.name: KC Concepcion
players.note: Left Week 5 vs NYJ (Oct 11) with a head injury after an illegal helmet-to-helmet hit. Coach Monken assumes he is in concussion protocol, and no return timeline has been given.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: No injury from the Oct 11 45-21 loss to DET; he simply had a poor game (4-30 on 7 targets) and is not on the injury report. Marvin Harrison's trade to HOU (official Oct 12) removes a target competitor permanently.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Still unsigned as of Oct 13; his agent said Oct 5 a deal was days away with KC the reported favorite. Hill testified Oct 9 in an ongoing civil trial and the NFL is reviewing under its Personal Conduct Policy, which clouds both a signing and his return.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Concussion on the second play of the Week 5 win over the Saints (Oct 11); ruled out and now in the NFL's five-step protocol. MIN is on bye in Week 6, so his earliest return is Oct 25 vs IND if he clears.

players.name: Kenyon Sadiq
players.note: Left the Oct 11 game vs CLE in the 3rd quarter with a concussion after a Quincy Williams hit that forced a fumble (2 catches, 2 yds). HC Aaron Glenn confirmed he is in the protocol; his Week 6 status is uncertain.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Returned from a right MCL sprain in Week 5 vs JAX in London (Oct 11) and led PHI in targets and catches (6/9, 38 yds) in the 19-17 loss. No setback reported.

players.name: George Kittle
players.note: Deebo Samuel hurt his hamstring in the Week 5 win over SEA, and Shanahan said Monday (Oct 12) he will miss at least a couple of weeks. That leaves Kittle, Mike Evans and CMC to carry the passing game.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.note: Was LAR's key TE target on MNF in the 37-34 OT loss to BUF (Oct 12), with at least 5 catches for 83 yds, though he also had a costly late false start.
